proposed_comments.title: (1/2) Escape workspace names before table output
proposed_comments.body:
### (1/2) Escape workspace names before table output

**Severity:** `medium`

Human-readable `list` writes saved workspace names verbatim, so ESC, CR/LF, or bidi controls can alter terminal output or forge rows. Apply the existing sanitizer here and at the application-name cell in the coordinated second suggestion; keep JSON values unchanged.

```suggestion
                          << winrt::to_string(WorkspacesCli::EscapeApprovalText(project.GetNamedString(L"name"))) << '\t';
```

confidence.rationale: The exact current summary-table path streams the saved workspace name directly; the existing sanitizer and regression test cover ESC, line breaks, and bidi controls. The literal candidate built at the pinned head.

selection_group.title: Escape both human-readable table name fields

proposed_comments.title: (2/2) Escape application names before table output
proposed_comments.body:
### (2/2) Escape application names before table output

**Severity:** `medium`

Application display names are also written verbatim to the human-readable table and can contain terminal controls or line separators. Apply the existing sanitizer here as well, atomically with the workspace-name change; leave the JSON output unchanged.

```suggestion
                    std::cout << winrt::to_string(WorkspacesCli::EscapeApprovalText(app.GetObjectW().GetNamedString(L"application")));
```

confidence.rationale: The application cell also bypasses the existing sanitizer; the helper has deterministic coverage and both exact literal changes built together at the pinned head.

selection_group.title: Escape both human-readable table name fields

proposed_comments.title: Include the handoff tests in the documented filter
proposed_comments.body:
### Include the handoff tests in the documented filter

**Severity:** `low`

The paragraph below describes `CliHandoffTests`, but this documented invocation excludes that class, so readers following the filter do not run those handoff checks. Add it to the filter.

```suggestion
    "/TestCaseFilter:FullyQualifiedName~CliApprovalTests|FullyQualifiedName~CliApprovalConsoleTests|FullyQualifiedName~CliContractTests|FullyQualifiedName~CliWorkerTests|FullyQualifiedName~CliHandoffTests|FullyQualifiedName~WorkspaceStoreTests"
```

confidence.rationale: The current documented filter omits the test class identified in the adjacent paragraph. The one-line candidate was built and the README blob is LF-only with no BOM.
